title: Matters of the Heart
shared_passage: Listen to three people talking about relationship issues. For questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).

questions.question: At the party, Emma…
options: liked Josh but didn't feel attracted to him at first.
thought she and Josh had good chemistry.
liked Josh although she thought he was a bit too forward.

questions.question: After a few dates she…
options: is completely in love with Josh.
thinks they are moving too fast.
is trying not to get too excited.

questions.question: Sofia…
options: used to admire Ashley a great deal.
has fallen out with Ashley and is mad at her.

questions.question: She feels…
options: Ashley may be bitter because of her bad breakup.
she spends too much time with Ashley.
it's not worth fighting for this relationship anymore.

questions.question: Daniel…
options: no longer has any feelings for his girlfriend.
works with her and feels they spend too much time together.
longs for a more passionate relationship.

questions.question: He thinks…
options: he and Laura don't put much effort into the relationship anymore.
a bit of drama occasionally wouldn't be so bad.
there is no future with Laura.
